title: Global Prime Multi-Storage Cabinet / Lateral File — 18"D x 65.6"H
body_html:
One footprint, two jobs: lockable shelf storage up top, three full lateral file drawers below.

The Global Prime multi-storage cabinet pairs a hinged-door compartment with an adjustable shelf over three lateral file drawers, putting binders, supplies, and active files within arm's reach of a single workstation. Fully welded reinforced steel and an anti-bounce-back drawer suspension stand up to daily institutional use, while a central lock keeps the whole unit secure. Built in Canada and configurable in 30 painted metal finishes plus 24 laminate options, it ships in 30", 36", or 42" widths at 18"D x 65.6"H.

Key features

  • Combination unit: hinged-door cabinet with adjustable shelf above three lateral file drawers
  • Reinforced, fully welded steel construction for institutional durability
  • Anti-bounce back drawer suspension system with interlock to prevent multi-drawer tip-out
  • Drawers accept letter, legal, and A4 files in front-to-back or side-to-side orientation
  • Central locking system secures the full unit
  • Choose from 30 painted metal finishes plus 24 laminate options for file tops and door fronts

Who it’s for

Records-heavy private offices, administrative areas, and shared workrooms in school boards, hospitals, and municipal offices that need filing and lockable storage in one footprint.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
